CustomField.description: A formula field to determine Attendee name when Attendee Type is "Internal" or "Customer" or "External" or "Virtual Agent"
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL( AttendeeType , 'Internal'), User.FirstName & " " & User.LastName , IF( OR(ISPICKVAL( AttendeeType , 'External'),ISPICKVAL( AttendeeType , 'VirtualAgent')) , Attendee_Name__c, IF(ISPICKVAL( AttendeeType , 'Customer'), Contact.FirstName & " " & Contact.LastName, '') ) )
CustomField.label: Attendee Name
